title: Find Indices With Index and Value Difference II
sourceKind: web-search-snippets (official page not fetchable; snippets cite leetcode.com and mirrors)
summary: Find i, j with |i - j| >= indexDifference and |nums[i] - nums[j]| >= valueDifference, returning [-1, -1] if none exists. i and j may be equal and any valid pair is accepted.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n <= 10^5; 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= indexDifference <= 10^5; 0 <= valueDifference <= 10^9 (as reported by search snippets; not confirmed on the official page). The visualization caps nums at 100 values and values at 1000.
visualizationNotes: Linear scan tracking the min and max index at least indexDifference behind j. Examples come from search snippets, not a fetched statement, so they are not marked as verified.
